paragraphs: We are a leading commercial cell engineering company focused on providing enabling platform technologies to advance the discovery, development and commercialization of next-generation cell therapeutics including cell and gene therapies and to support innovative cell-based research and development. Over more than two decades, we have developed and commercialized our proprietary Flow Electroporation® technology, which is used by biopharmaceutical companies in the complex engineering of a wide variety of cells.

Electroporation is a method of transfection, or the process of deliberately introducing molecules into cells, that involves applying an electric field in order to temporarily increase the permeability of the cell membrane. This precisely controlled increase in permeability allows the intracellular delivery of molecules, such as genetic material and proteins, that would not normally be able to cross the cell membrane as easily.

With increased knowledge of cell complexity and systems biology in the scientific community, researchers have sought to leverage or repurpose cell functions and/or machinery for research or therapeutic purposes. The ability to engineer living cells by introducing foreign molecules, such as gene editing systems and transgenes, has led to a revolution in biological research and resulted in numerous biological discoveries. Living human cells can also be engineered ex vivo, or outside the body, where they are repaired or reprogrammed to fight disease. In this case, the engineered cell itself is the drug.

Cell therapy has emerged as one of the fastest growing and most promising treatment modalities to address a host of human diseases. Recent developments in multiple U.S. Food and Drug Administration (the "FDA") approved cell therapies in generating promising data suggests that they may be able to provide long-lasting amelioration of symptoms or presence of disease has catalyzed tremendous investment—leading to significant growth in cell-based therapies being evaluated for therapeutic applications. The Alliance for Regenerative Medicine ("ARM"), an international advocacy organization, estimates that the regenerative medicine sector, which consists of gene, cell, and tissue-based therapeutic developers raised an aggregate of $11.1 billion in 2025 and that, as of December 2025, there were more than 2,120 active clinical trials focused on regenerative and advanced medicine, which includes gene therapy, cell-based immuno-oncology, cell therapy and tissue engineering.

Our ExPERT platform, which is based on our Flow Electroporation technology, has been designed to address this rapidly expanding cell therapy market and can be utilized across the continuum of the high-growth cell therapy sector, from discovery and development through commercialization of next-generation, cell-based medicines. The ExPERT family of products includes five instruments, which we call the DTx™, the ATx™, the STx™, the GTx™, and the VLx™, as well as a portfolio of proprietary related disposables and consumables. We launched our DTx electroporation platform for discovery in February 2026. Our disposables include PAs designed for use with our instruments and our consumables include accessories supporting PAs such as electroporation buffer solution and software protocols. We have garnered meaningful expertise in cell engineering via our internal research and development efforts as well as our customer-focused commercial approach, which includes an application scientist team. The platform is also supported by a robust intellectual property portfolio with more than 200 granted U.S. and foreign patents and more than 100 pending patent applications worldwide.

From leading commercial cell therapy drug and biologic developers and top biopharmaceutical companies to top academic and government research institutions, including the U.S. National Institutes of Health ("NIH"), our customers have extensively validated our technology. We believe the features and performance of our platform have led to sustained customer engagement. Our existing customer base, which includes but is not limited to our 32 SPL customers, ranges from large biopharmaceutical companies, including a majority of the top 25 pharmaceutical companies based on 2024 global revenue, to hundreds of biotechnology companies and academic centers focused on translational research. Our
Flow Electroporation® technology is used by one of our SPL customers to engineer the first ex-vivo cell therapy approved by the FDA in December 2023.

In January 2025, we acquired SeQure Dx, ("SeQure") a market leader for on-target and off-target editing assessment services for cell and gene therapies. We expect that this acquisition will strengthen our ability to serve ex vivo and in vivo cell and gene therapy developers with an innovative suite of tools and services spanning early R&D through clinical development and commercialization. The integration of SeQure into our Company has allowed us to expand our service offerings for our partners and leverage our commercial and field application scientist teams to work with developers earlier in their research processes.
We believe our industry leadership position and continued growth will be driven by the following competitive strengths:

• Proprietary technology platform that can unlock the significant potential of cell-based therapeutics. We built our ExPERT platform to advance the growing demands for non-viral delivery and next-generation cell and gene engineering approaches. Our ExPERT platform enables delivery of almost any molecule into almost any cell type. We believe our ExPERT platform leads the industry in performance, as measured by consistency, efficiency, viability, flexibility and scale. Our ExPERT platform is further supported by a robust intellectual property portfolio. Our assay technologies, GUIDE-seq, ONE-seq, Guide Profiler, SAFER Detection, and others, acquired through the acquisition of SeQure, are a suite of assays that were exclusively licensed or developed internally at SeQure and measure on-target gene editing, off-target gene editing, and other complex genomic events that can provide critical information for developers and regulators.

• Comprehensive, high-performance transfection platform. We believe our ExPERT platform offers a unique value proposition given the flexibility to scale up from research to current good manufacturing practices ("cGMP") manufacturing on a single platform— enabling the engineering of cells ranging from tens of thousands of cells to more than tens of billions of cells in a single transfection run taking 30 minutes or less. Our long-term internal engineering expertise is supplemented by our customer focused approach—with an application scientist team working with our customers across increasingly diverse applications.

• Capitalizing on the large and growing next-generation cell therapy market with the ability to take advantage of rising demand for non-viral approaches. We believe we are well positioned to increase our market share within the large and growing next-generation cell therapy market. Since the FDA approved the first engineered CAR-T cell therapies to treat blood-based cancers in 2017, the number of cell therapy candidates being evaluated pre-clinically and clinically has grown significantly. We expect growth to continue given the remaining high unmet medical need in cancer and other chronic conditions and predict increased investments in cell therapy product development across a variety of human diseases. We expect to continue to grow our market share given the high performance of our platform and the ongoing adoption of non-viral delivery methods as the cell and gene therapy industry has trended towards developing advanced cell-based therapies with complex engineering strategies to improve efficacy, reduce time to patient treatment and expand into new indications.

• Innovative SPL agreement business model focused on value creation and shared success. Our SPL agreements allow us to participate in the value creation of our customers' programs via precommercial milestones and in commercial sales-based payments. We intend to continue to build a portfolio of strategic relationships with cell therapy developers, which provide us with a growing, diversified source of annual licenses and potential downstream revenue.

In addition to the high performance and flexibility of the ExPERT platform, we believe our licensing model further reduces clinical risk and development timelines for our cell therapy customers. By entering into SPL agreements with us, for example, our customers gain access to our FDA Master File to support their IND-enabling studies and potentially shortening clinical development. headings: Risks Related to Our Business and Growth Strategy
We may be unable to successfully execute on our growth strategy.
We rely on assumptions, estimates and data to calculate certain of our key metrics, and real or perceived inaccuracies in such metrics may harm our reputation and negatively affect our business.
Our future success is dependent upon our ability to increase penetration in our existing markets and expand into adjacent markets.
We may be unable to compete successfully against our existing or future competitors.
Our current research and development efforts may not produce significant revenue for several years, if at all.
Our international operations may raise additional risks, which could have an adverse effect on our operating results.
If we fail to offer high-quality customer service, our business and reputation could suffer.
If we cannot maintain and expand current SPL agreements and enter into new agreements that generate marketed licensed products, our business could be adversely affected.
The failure of our customers to meet their contractual obligations to us could adversely affect our business.

paragraphs: You should consider carefully the following risks and other information contained in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, including the section of this report captioned "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" and our financial statements and related notes. If any of the events contemplated by the following discussion of risks should occur, our business, results of operations, financial condition, and growth prospects could suffer significantly. The risks below are not the only ones we face. Additional risks that we currently do not know about or that we currently believe to be immaterial may also impair our business.

We are a cell engineering and life sciences company and have incurred significant losses since our inception, and we expect to incur losses for the foreseeable future. We have limited product offerings approved for commercial sale and may never achieve or maintain profitability.

We are a cell engineering and life sciences company focused on advancing the discovery, development and commercialization of next-generation cell-based medicines. The biopharmaceutical development industry, where the majority of our customers operate, is a highly speculative undertaking and involves a substantial degree of risk. We have incurred significant losses since inception and have financed our operations principally through private financings and public offerings of our securities. We have historically relied on sales and licensing of our instruments, as well as sales of our portfolio of single-use disposable PAs for the significant majority of our revenue. We may be unable to sell or license our instruments to new customers and existing customers may cease or reduce their utilization of our instruments or fail to renew licenses of our instruments. Our net losses were $44.6 million and $41.1 million for the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively. As of December 31, 2025, we had an accumulated deficit of $261.5 million. Our losses

have resulted principally from expenses incurred for research and development for our cell engineering platforms and from sales and marketing costs, manufacturing expenses, management and administrative costs as well as other expenses that we have incurred while building our business infrastructure.

We expect that our expenses and operating losses may continue for the foreseeable future as we expand our research and development efforts, expand the capabilities of our cell engineering platforms and operate as a public company in the United States. We anticipate that our expenses will increase as we:

paragraphs: You should read the following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations in conjunction with our consolidated financial statements and related notes thereto included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, as well as the other information provided from time to time in our other filings with the SEC. Some of the information contained in this discussion and analysis or set forth elsewhere in this annual report, including information with respect to our plans and strategy for our business, includes forward-looking statements that involve risks and uncertainties. As a result of many factors, our actual results could differ materially from those discussed in or implied by these forward-looking statements. Factors that could cause or contribute to such differences include, but are not limited to, those discussed in the section of this Annual Report on Form 10-K titled "Risk Factors." Please also see the section titled "Special Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements."

We are a leading commercial cell engineering company focused on providing enabling platform technologies to advance the discovery, development and commercialization of next-generation cell therapeutics and to support innovative cell-based research and development. Over more than two decades, we have developed and commercialized our proprietary Flow Electroporation technology, which facilitates complex engineering of a wide variety of cells. Electroporation is a method of transfection, or the process of deliberately introducing molecules into cells, that involves applying an electric field in order to temporarily increase the permeability of the cell membrane. This precisely controlled increase in permeability allows the intracellular delivery of molecules, such as genetic material and proteins, that would not normally be able to cross the cell membrane as easily.

Our ExPERT platform, which is based on our Flow Electroporation technology, has been designed to address this rapidly expanding cell therapy market and can be utilized across the continuum of the high-growth cell therapy sector, from discovery and development through commercialization of next-generation, cell-based therapies. The ExPERT family of products includes five instruments, which we call the DTx, the ATx, the STx, the GTx, and the VLx, and related software protocols, as well as a portfolio of proprietary related PAs and consumables.

We have garnered meaningful expertise in cell engineering via our internal research and development efforts as well as our customer-focused commercial approach, which includes a growing application scientist team. The platform is also supported by a robust intellectual property portfolio with more than 200 granted U.S. and foreign patents and more than 100 pending patent applications worldwide.

From leading commercial cell therapy drug and biologic developers and top biopharmaceutical companies to top academic and government research institutions, including the NIH, our customers have extensively validated our technology. We believe the features and performance of our platform have led to sustained customer engagement. Our existing customer base ranges from large biopharmaceutical companies, including a majority of the top 25 pharmaceutical companies based on 2024 global revenue, to hundreds of biotechnology companies and academic centers focused on translational research. As of December 31, 2025, we have placed more than 857 of our electroporation instruments with customers worldwide.

Historically, we have financed our operations primarily from the issuance and sale of equity securities, previous debt borrowings and cash flows from operations. On August 3, 2021, we issued and sold 15,525,000 shares of common stock in our U.S. IPO at a price to the public of $13.00 per share, inclusive of 2,025,000 shares issued pursuant to the full exercise of the underwriters' option to purchase additional shares. The IPO generated gross proceeds to us of $201.8 million. We received aggregate net proceeds of $184.3 million after deducting aggregate underwriting commissions and offering costs of $17.6 million.

We believe that our current cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments will enable us to fund our operating expenses and capital expenditure requirements for at least the next 12 months from the date of the filing of this Annual Report. We have based this estimate on assumptions that may prove to be wrong, however, and we could exhaust our
available capital resources sooner than we expect. See "Liquidity and Capital Resources" below for more information about our current capital resources.

Since our inception, we have incurred significant operating losses. Our ability to generate revenue sufficient to achieve profitability will depend on the successful further development and commercialization of our products. We generated revenue of $33.0 million and $38.6 million for the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively, and incurred net losses of $44.6 million and $41.1 million for those same years. As of December 31, 2025, we had an accumulated deficit of $261.5 million. We expect to continue to incur net losses as we focus on growing commercial sales of our products in both the United States and international markets, including growing our sales teams, scaling our manufacturing operations, and continuing research and development efforts to develop new products and further enhance our existing products.

We believe we have a diversified revenue model with revenue generated from multiple sources including recurring license fees, sales of instruments and related PAs and participation in the clinical and commercial success of some of our customers through milestone and sales-based payments under SPL agreements.

We believe that our financial performance has been, and in the foreseeable future will continue to be, primarily driven by the following factors. While each of these factors presents significant opportunities for our business, they also pose challenges that we must successfully address in order to sustain our growth and improve our results of operations. Our ability to successfully address the factors below is subject to various risks and uncertainties, including those described in this Annual Report under the heading "Risk Factors."

Our financial performance has largely been driven by, and in the future will continue to be impacted by, the rate of sales and licenses of our ExPERT family of proprietary Flow Electroporation instruments to existing and new customers. We currently market five versions of our instruments, the DTx, the ATx, the STx, the GTx, and the VLx.. The ATx is primarily to academic institutions and investigative research users. The STx is primarily sold to end users for research and drug discovery purposes, and the GTx is licensed to customers for research, clinical or commercial use or sold for research use in certain circumstances or sold to academic centers for research or clinical use. We launched the VLx to provide our customers with an easier to use system that incorporates the benefits of the ExPERT platform. We announced the launch the DTx in February 2026. We view the demand for our instruments, whether in the form of sales or license, as an indicator of the health of our current business and as a predictor of future instrument sale and license revenue. As described below, we separately sell proprietary single-use processing assemblies, which we call PAs, that are necessary for our customers to use our electroporation instruments. Therefore, depending on the number of instruments that have been sold or are under active license, we have insight into the demand for PAs that will also translate to future revenue for us.

Our sales model varies based on the activity of the end customer, such as whether they are a translational research center, an academic center, a company focused on drug or biologic discovery, or a company engaged in cell therapy development, and the customer's intended use of our platform. If our customer intends to use our platform for research or discovery only, we typically sell the instrument outright. Each of the ExPERT instruments have different prices based on the instrument's features. When we sell an instrument, we also provide a non-exclusive license to our intellectual property for the customer to use the instrument broadly for research or discovery, as applicable. In the case of a sale, title to the instrument conveys to the buyer, but we retain ownership of intellectual property rights and software and protocols loaded onto the instruments.

The sales cycle for our cell engineering instruments varies widely and typically ranges from approximately six to approximately 12 months, with the actual period depending on project stage, budget process, equipment prioritization and the general financial status of the customer or the market in general. As a result of this lengthy and unpredictable sales cycle, we expect that we may be prone to quarterly fluctuations in our instrument sales revenue.

paragraphs: 本公司為一家領導的商業細胞工程公司，專注於提供使能平台技術，以促進次世代細胞療法的發現、開發與商業化，包括細胞與基因療法，並支持創新性的細胞基研究與開發。在超過二十年的時間中，本公司已開發並商業化我們專有的 Flow Electroporation® 技術，該技術被生物製藥公司用於廣泛細胞的複雜工程。
電穿孔是一種轉染方法，或故意將分子引入細胞的過程，其涉及施加電場以暫時增加細胞膜的通透性。這種精確控制的通透性增加，允許分子（如遺傳物質與蛋白質）進入細胞內，這些分子通常無法輕易穿越細胞膜。
隨著科學界對細胞複雜性與系統生物學的知識增加，研究人員已尋求利用或重新用途細胞功能與/或機械裝置，以進行研究或治療用途。能夠透過引入外來分子（如基因編輯系統與轉基因）來工程化活細胞，已導致生物研究的革命，並產生許多生物學發現。活的人類細胞也可以在體外（即體外）進行工程化，於此過程中，細胞被修復或重新編程以對抗疾病。在此情況下，工程化的細胞本身即為藥物。

細胞療法已成為解決多種人類疾病最快速成長且最具前景的治療方式之一。美國食品藥物管理局（"FDA"）最近批准的多種細胞療法的發展，產生了令人鼓舞的數據，顯示這些療法可能能提供長期的症狀緩解或疾病存在情況的改善，這已引發巨大的投資，導致評估用於治療應用的細胞基療法顯著成長。再生醫學聯盟（"ARM"），一個國際倡議組織，估計再生醫學產業，包括基因、細胞與組織基療法開發者，在 2025 年共籌得 11.1 十億美元，且截至 2025 年 12 月，有超過 2,120 個活躍的臨牀試驗專注於再生與先進醫學，包括基因療法、基於細胞的免疫腫瘤學、細胞療法與組織工程。

我們的 ExPERT 平台，基於我們的 Flow Electroporation 技術，已設計用以應對這快速成長的細胞療法市場，並可應用於高成長細胞療法產業的整個連續體，從發現與開發至次世代細胞基藥物的商業化。ExPERT 系列產品包括五種儀器，我們稱為 DTx™、ATx™、STx™、GTx™ 和 VLx™，以及一組專有的相關消耗品與耗材。我們於 2026 年 2 月推出我們的 DTx 電穿孔平台用於發現。我們的消耗品包括為我們儀器設計的 PAs，而我們的耗材包括支援 PAs 的配件，如電穿孔緩衝液溶液與軟體協議。我們透過內部研究與開發努力以及以客戶為導向的商業策略，已累積了重要的細胞工程專業知識，此策略包括應用科學家團隊。該平台也受到一個強大的智慧財產權組合支持，擁有超過 200 個已授權的美國與外國專利，以及全球超過 100 個待審專利申請。
從領導的商業細胞療法藥物與生物製品開發者與頂級生物製藥公司，到頂級的學術與政府研究機構，包括美國國家衛生研究院（"NIH"），我們的客戶已廣泛驗證我們的技術。我們相信我們平台的特點與表現已導致持續的客戶參與。我們現有的客戶羣，包括但不限於我們的 32 SPL 客戶，範圍從大型生物製藥公司，包括根據 2024 年全球營收排名前 25 的藥品公司，到數百家專注於轉譯研究的生物技術公司與學術中心。我們
Flow Electroporation® 技術被我們的一位 SPL 客戶用於工程化第一個獲得 FDA 批准的體外細胞療法，於 2023 年 12 月。

我們於 2025 年 1 月收購了 SeQure Dx（"SeQure"），一家在目標與非目標編輯評估服務領域的市場領導者，用於細胞與基因療法。我們預期此收購將強化我們服務體外與體內細胞與基因療法開發者的能力建立，提供一套創新工具與服務，涵蓋從早期研發至臨牀開發與商業化。SeQure 與我們公司的整合已使我們能擴展對合作夥伴的服務項目，並利用我們的商業與現場應用科學家團隊，在開發者的研發過程早期階段進行合作。
我們相信本公司在產業中的領導地位與持續成長將由以下競爭優勢所驅動：

• 專利技術平台，可發揮細胞治療的潛在價值。我們建置了 ExPERT 平台，以應對非病毒遞送與次世代細胞及基因工程方法日益增長的需求。ExPERT 平台可將幾乎任何分子遞送至幾乎任何細胞類型。我們相信 ExPERT 平台在性能方面領先產業，以一致性、效率、存活率、靈活性與規模為衡量標準。ExPERT 平台進一步受到強大的智慧財產權組合支持。我們的檢測技術，包括 GUIDE-seq、ONE-seq、Guide Profiler、SAFER Detection 等，透過收購 SeQure 而取得，是專屬授權或內部開發的檢測技術組合，用以衡量目標基因編輯、非目標基因編輯及其他複雜的基因組事件，可為開發者與監管機構提供關鍵資訊。
• 全面且高性能的轉染平台。我們相信 ExPERT 平台提供獨特的價值主張，因其可在單一平台中靈活擴展，從研究階段至符合美國現行良好製造規範（"cGMP"）製造。這使我們能在單次轉染運行中，於 30 分鐘或更短時間內處理從數萬至數十億細胞的工程化細胞。我們的長期內部工程專業知識，並透過以客戶為中心的作法加以補強—與客戶合作，應對越來越多元的應用場景。

• 抓住次世代細胞治療市場的規模與成長，並能利用對非病毒方法需求上升的機會。我們相信我們在這個規模龐大且持續成長的次世代細胞治療市場中，有機會提高市佔率。自 2017 年美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）批准首個用於治療血液癌症的工程化 CAR-T 細胞治療後，正在進行臨牀前與臨牀評估的細胞治療候選品種顯著增加。我們預期成長將持續，因癌症及其他慢性疾病的高未滿足醫療需求，以及對細胞治療產品開發的投資將持續增加於多種人類疾病。我們預期將持續提高市佔率，因我們平台的高性能，以及非病毒遞送方法的持續採用，而細胞與基因治療產業正趨向開發具有複雜工程策略的先進細胞治療，以提高療效、縮短患者治療時間並拓展至新適應症。
• 以價值創造與共享成功為核心的創新 SPL 合約商業模式。SPL 合約使我們能透過預商業里程碑與商業銷售基於付款，參與客戶專案的價值創造。我們意圖持續建立與細胞治療開發者的戰略關係，為我們提供日益多元且穩定的年度授權收入與潛在後續收入來源。

paragraphs: 您應閱讀下列對我們財務狀況及營運成果的討論與分析，並配合我們的合併財務報表及其相關附註，以及其他本年度10-K申報表中所載之資訊，以及我們不時提交給SEC的其他資料。部分本討論與分析中所載資訊，或於本年度報告其他地方所載資訊，包括有關我們業務計畫與策略的資訊，包含風險與不確定性之預測性陳述。由於許多因素，我們的實際結果可能與這些預測性陳述中所討論或暗示的結果有重大差異。導致此差異的因素包括，但不僅限於，本年度10-K申報表中標題為「風險因素」部分所討論的那些因素。請同時參閱標題為「預測性陳述特別說明」的部分。

我們是一家領導的商業細胞工程公司，專注於提供啟動平台技術，以促進次世代細胞療法的發現、開發與商業化，並支持創新細胞基研究與開發。在超過二十年的時間裡，我們已開發並商業化我們專有的Flow Electroporation技術，該技術有助於複雜工程各種細胞。電穿孔是一種轉染方法，或故意將分子引入細胞的過程，涉及施加電場以暫時增加細胞膜的通透性。這種精確控制的通透性增加，允許將分子（如遺傳物質和蛋白質）送入細胞內，這些分子通常無法輕易穿透細胞膜。
我們的ExPERT平台基於我們的Flow Electroporation技術，設計用以應對這個快速成長的細胞療法市場，並可應用於高成長細胞療法產業的整個連續體，從發現與開發到次世代細胞基療法的商業化。ExPERT產品系列包括五種儀器，我們稱為DTx、ATx、STx、GTx和VLx，以及相關軟體協議，以及一組專有的相關PAs和消耗品。
我們透過內部研究與開發工作以及以客戶為導向的商業策略，已積累了關於細胞工程的重要專業知識，這包括一個日益成長的應用科學家團隊。該平台也受到一個強大的智慧財產權組合支持，擁有超過200項已授權的美國及外國專利，以及全球超過100項待審專利申請。

從領導的商業細胞療法藥物與生物製劑開發者與頂尖生物製藥公司，到頂尖的學術與政府研究機構，包括NIH，我們的客戶已廣泛驗證我們的技術。我們相信我們平台的特性與表現已導致持續的客戶參與。我們現有的客戶羣體範圍從大型生物製藥公司，包括根據2024年全球營收排名前25名的大多數藥物公司，到數百家專注於轉譯研究的生物科技公司與學術中心。截至2025年12月31日，我們已向全球客戶出貨超過857臺電穿孔儀器。
歷來，我們主要透過發行與銷售股權證券、先前的債務借款以及營運現金流來資助我們的營運。2021年8月3日，我們發行並銷售了15,525,000股普通股於美國IPO，每股價格為13.00美元，包含2,025,000股根據發行機構選擇權完全行使後發行的股票。IPO為我們帶來了201.8 百萬美元的總收入。扣除總共17.6 百萬美元的發行機構佣金及發行費用後，我們收到總共184.3 百萬美元的淨資金。
我們認為我們目前的現金、現金等價物及短期投資將足以資助我們至少接下來12個月的營運費用與資本支出需求，自本年度報告申報日算起。我們的估計基於可能證明錯誤的假設，因此我們可能比預期更早耗盡可用的資金。請參閱下方「流動性及資金來源」部分以取得更多關於我們目前資金來源的資訊。
我們相信我們目前的現金、現金等價物及短期投資將足以資助我們至少接下來12個月的營運費用與資本支出需求，自本年度報告申報日算起。我們的估計基於可能證明錯誤的假設，因此我們可能比預期更早耗盡可用的資金。請參閱下方「流動性及資金來源」部分以取得更多關於我們目前資金來源的資訊。
我們認為我們擁有多元化的收入模式，收入來自多個來源，包括重複性授權費用、儀器及相關PAs的銷售，以及透過SPL契約下的里程碑及銷售基準付款參與部分客戶的臨牀與商業成功。
我們認為，我們的財務表現已受到，且在可預見的未來將繼續受到以下因素的影響。雖然這些因素為我們的業務帶來顯著的機會，但它們同時也帶來我們必須成功解決的挑戰，以維持我們的成長並改善我們的營運結果。我們能否成功解決以下因素，受到多種風險與不確定性影響，包括本年度報告中「風險因素」部分所述的風險。

我們的財務表現主要受到，且未來將繼續受到我們ExPERT系列專利流電穿孔儀器對現有及新客戶的銷售與授權速率的影響。我們目前行銷五種儀器版本，分別為DTx、ATx、STx、GTx及VLx。ATx主要銷售給學術機構及研究使用者。STx主要銷售給終端使用者用於研究及藥物發現用途，GTx則授權給客戶用於研究、臨牀或商業用途，或在特定情況下銷售用於研究用途，或銷售給學術中心用於研究或臨牀用途。我們發佈VLx以提供客戶一個更易使用的系統，該系統整合了ExPERT平台的優點。我們在2026年2月宣佈發佈DTx。我們將儀器的銷售需求，無論是以銷售或授權形式，視為我們當前業務健康的指標，並作為未來儀器銷售與授權收入的預測。

我們的銷售模式會根據終端客戶的活動而有所不同，例如客戶是否為轉譯研究中心、學術中心、專注於藥物或生物製品發現的公司，或從事細胞治療開發的公司，以及客戶對我們平台的預期用途。如果客戶預期僅用於研究或發現用途，我們通常會將儀器直接銷售給客戶。每種ExPERT儀器的價格因儀器的特性而有所不同。當我們銷售儀器時，我們也會提供客戶非獨佔的智慧財產權授權，讓客戶可以廣泛使用儀器進行研究或發現，視情況而定。在銷售情況下，儀器的所有權轉移給買方，但我們保留智慧財產權、軟體及載入儀器的協議的擁有權。
我們細胞工程儀器的銷售週期變化很大，通常範圍約為6至12個月，實際週期取決於專案階段、預算程序、設備優先順序以及客戶或市場的總體財務狀況。因此，由於這個長且不可預測的銷售週期，我們預期可能面臨季度間儀器銷售收入的波動。

headings: 與本公司業務及成長策略相關之風險
本公司可能無法成功執行成長策略。
我們依賴假設、估計及數據計算部分關鍵指標，若這些指標存在實質或被認為不準確的情況，可能損害本公司聲譽，並對業務產生負面影響。
本公司未來的成功取決於我們能否提高現有市場的市佔率，並拓展至相關市場。
本公司可能無法成功與現有或未來競爭對手競爭。
本公司目前的研究與開發工作可能在數年內甚至完全無法產生顯著收入。
本公司國際業務可能帶來額外風險，可能對營運成果產生負面影響。
若本公司未能提供高品質之客戶服務，業務與聲譽可能受損。
若我們無法維持並擴展現有 SPL 合約，並與新合作夥伴簽訂能產生市場化授權產品之契約，將可能對本公司業務造成不利影響。
若我們的客戶未能履行對我們的契約義務，將可能對本公司業務造成不利影響。
在近期期間，我們的收入來源依賴有限數量的客戶，若失去其中任何一者，將可能對本公司業務造成不利影響。
我們已進行並可能未來進行併購，此舉可能幹擾本公司業務，造成股東持股稀釋，並損害本公司財務狀況與營運成果。
paragraphs: 您應仔細考慮本年度報告表10-K中所包含的風險及其他資訊，包括本報告中標題為「管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析」的節，以及我們的財務報表及相關附註。若有任何本風險討論中所預期的事件發生，將可能對我們的業務、營運成果、財務狀況及成長前景造成重大影響。上述風險並非我們所面臨的唯一風險。我們目前未知或認為不重要的其他風險，也可能影響我們的業務。
本公司為一間細胞工程與生命科學公司，自設立以來已產生重大虧損，且預期在可預見的未來仍將持續虧損。我們目前僅有有限的產品已獲得商業銷售許可，可能永遠無法達成或維持獲利。

本公司為一間專注於推動次世代細胞基藥物之發現、開發與商業化之細胞工程與生命科學公司。在本公司主要客戶所屬之生物製藥開發產業，為一高度投機性產業，並涉及相當程度之風險。自成立以來，本公司已產生重大虧損，並主要透過私人融資及公開發行本公司證券來支應營運資金。本公司歷來主要透過銷售及授權我們之儀器，以及銷售我們之單次使用一次性PA產品組合來取得營收之重大部分。本公司可能無法向新客戶銷售或授權我們之儀器，現有客戶可能停止或減少使用我們之儀器，或未續約我們之儀器授權。本公司之淨虧損為2025年12月31日財年為44.6 百萬美元，2024年12月31日財年為41.1 百萬美元。2025年12月31日，本公司累計虧損為261.5 百萬美元。本公司虧損
主要來自於我們細胞工程平台之研究與開發費用，以及銷售與行銷費用、製造費用、管理與行政費用，以及其他在建立我們業務基礎設施過程中產生的費用。
我們預期在可預見的未來，隨著我們擴展研究與開發工作、擴充我們細胞工程平台的技術能力，並作為美國上市公司運作，我們的費用與營運虧損可能持續。我們預期我們的費用將因以下原因而增加：
• 繼續推進我們的ex vivo細胞工程平台，並開發與我們平台相關的新技術；
